FX-CTC-001.says: The settings as they start: from #ff0000 to #0080ff, Hue, by setting, hue tolerance 5, lightness and saturation tolerance 50, softness 50. The red, its shadow 5.5 degrees round the wheel, its highlight, the dark red and the red at half covering take #0080ff's hue, each keeping its own lightness and saturation, so the shading stays; the dull red, too far from #ff0000's saturation, the pink and the skin's shadow, 15 degrees round, and every other colour are untouched.

FX-CTC-002.says: From #c82828, the drawing's own red: the same, and now the dull red, its saturation 0.524 from the red's, just past the tolerance of 0.5, is changed nine tenths of the way.

FX-CTC-003.says: Change Hue & Lightness: the changed colours also take #0080ff's lightness, 0.5, so the shadow, the highlight and the dark red lose their light and dark.

FX-CTC-004.says: Change Hue & Saturation: the changed colours take #0080ff's saturation, 1, each keeping its own lightness.

FX-CTC-005.says: Change Hue, Lightness & Saturation: every changed colour becomes #0080ff itself; the dull red nine tenths of the way there.

FX-CTC-006.says: Change By transforming, Hue: each changed hue is turned by as far as #0080ff's is from #c82828's, 209.9 degrees, so the shadow, 354.5 degrees, lands at 204.4, not 209.9.

FX-CTC-007.says: Change By transforming, Hue, Lightness & Saturation: each changed colour's lightness is raised by 0.029 and its saturation by 1/3, held at 1, as #0080ff is lighter and fuller than #c82828.

FX-CTC-008.says: Hue tolerance 0, softness 0: only a hue exactly the red's changes; the red, the highlight, the dark red and the soft red do, the shadow does not, and the dull red, at softness 0, is past its saturation tolerance.

FX-CTC-009.says: Hue tolerance 10, softness 0, 18 degrees each way: the pink and the skin's shadow, 15 degrees off, change whole with the reds; the skin, 25.7 off, does not.

FX-CTC-010.says: Softness 0 at the other settings as they start: FX-CTC-002 with the dull red untouched.

FX-CTC-011.says: Softness 100: the band past each tolerance is as wide as the tolerance, so the pink changes a third of the way, the skin's shadow a third, and the dull red 95 hundredths.

FX-CTC-012.says: View Correction Matte on, at FX-CTC-002's settings: every pixel that shows is grey, white where the colour changes whole, black where not at all, and the dull red's nine tenths between, each at its own covering.

FX-CTC-013.says: To #808080, a grey, with Hue & Saturation: the reds turn grey, each at its own lightness.

FX-CTC-014.says: From #808080, a grey, has no hue: no colour is near it, and the drawing is untouched.

FX-CTC-015.says: All three tolerances 100: every colour takes #0080ff's hue, each keeping its lightness and saturation; the grey, having no saturation, stays grey.

FX-CTC-016.says: Hue tolerance keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 20 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 changes only the hues exactly red's, fading nothing in, since a tolerance of 0 has no band; frame 2, at 10, takes in the pink and the skin's shadow and a seventh of the skin; frame 4, at 20, the skin whole.

FX-CTC-017.says: Lightness tolerance keyed from 10 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, eased past its end: frame 0 changes the red whole, the shadow, 0.137 from its lightness, a quarter, and neither the highlight nor the dark red; frame 2 is held at 100 and is frame 4.

FX-CTC-018.says: FX-CTC-002 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-CTC-019.says: FX-CTC-002 with its colours written in capitals, #C82828 and #0080FF: the same.

FX-CTC-020.says: Hue tolerance 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CTC-021.says: Softness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CTC-022.says: Saturation tolerance keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CTC-023.says: A from colour written "#ff00", two digits short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CTC-024.says: A to colour written "blue", a name, not #rrggbb. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CTC-025.says: A change written "saturation", not one of the four. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CTC-026.says: A change by written "shift", not "setting" or "transforming". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CTC-027.says: A view matte written "yes", not "off" or "on". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
